sequential.method: LEChain §7.3: send, wait for inclusion, repeat

method.commit_time: first observation of the including block by a watcher polling every 20 ms
method.gas_limit: eth_estimateGas x 1.25 per call type, as web3.py (LEChain's client) estimates
method.ours_anchoring: an AIS worker thread with its own account signs (ML-DSA-65 + SLH-DSA co-signature) and submits each closed epoch while ingest continues
method.ours_event_time: when the record is signed, indexed and in the epoch tree; our client-side signing is before it, as LEChain's pre-signing is before its submission
method.rates: not computed here; mkfigs divides events by the recorded span

order_gas_by_k.config: D4: the order's 0x05 leaf digest recorded on chain; sigma_CO verified by the AIS and auditors

ours.anchor_is: commitRoot(cid, R_e, leafCount, d_prev, d_e, A_e): no signature on chain (D4); the approval set travels off chain
ours.anchor_mldsa_sign_is: the M custodian approvals of d_e, together
ours.orders_are: one FULL/ERASED sweep order per epoch that disposes anything; its 0x05 digest recorded by orderRedaction before that epoch's anchor (§1v.4, D4)
